propositions: _assemble_context_uncached silently swallows list_tickets and per-child show_ticket failures with bare except Exception, leaving children empty and has_children=False without recording incompleteness
When hierarchy_incomplete is False, container-scoped DET checks (p5_task_dag, p8_reviewability) return trivial pass instead of reporting incompleteness, violating parent epic AC #4
PlanContext lacks hierarchy_incomplete and hierarchy_incomplete_detail fields to track whether child enumeration or per-child fetch failed
finalize_verdict and drift_floor._recompute_verdict_after_drop do not check for hierarchy incompleteness and convert it to INDETERMINATE verdict
plan_review_precheck_output.schema.json does not declare hierarchy_incomplete/hierarchy_incomplete_detail fields, blocking threading through coverage dicts to multiple finalize_verdict call sites
plan-review.yaml coach steps do not pass hierarchy_incomplete/hierarchy_incomplete_detail from precheck outputs via ctx.inputs, defeating coach-path flag propagation
